meta.note: Calendrical and astronomical bars. Every row subtracts absolute points from the 100-point total and may set a veto. Rows whose underlying fact is APPROXIMATE (the eclipse detector) are marked confidence:'low' and must never veto on their own — see risk R3 in the master plan; they carry veto:false and a visible 'approximate' note instead.

translations.en: Eclipse day (approximate detection) — all auspicious acts are suspended.
translations.hi: ग्रहण दिवस (सन्निकट गणना) — समस्त शुभ कर्म वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: During grahana only japa, dana and snana are prescribed. The detector here uses the Sun's distance from the lunar node at syzygy; it is an approximation and knows nothing of visibility from your location. Confirm against a panchanga before acting on it.

translations.en: Within three days of an eclipse (approximate) — the sutaka period reduces auspiciousness.
translations.hi: ग्रहण के तीन दिन के भीतर (सन्निकट) — सूतक काल, शुभत्व न्यून।

rules.interpretation: The sutaka observance surrounding an eclipse varies by tradition (9 or 12 hours before a solar eclipse, 3 days in some stricter reckonings). A moderate penalty rather than a bar.

translations.en: Sankranti — the Sun changes sign; a punya-kala reserved for dana and snana, not for samskaras.
translations.hi: संक्रान्ति — सूर्य राशि परिवर्तन; पुण्यकाल दान-स्नान हेतु, संस्कार हेतु नहीं।

rules.interpretation: The sixteen ghatikas around the ingress are punya-kala. Conjugal union is among the acts set aside on Sankranti in the Parva-varjya lists.

translations.en: Adhika (intercalary) Masa — no auspicious samskara is performed in the extra month.
translations.hi: अधिक मास — मलमास में कोई शुभ संस्कार नहीं।

rules.interpretation: The month with no solar ingress is called mala-masa or purushottama-masa. Nitya and naimittika rites continue, but kamya samskaras such as Garbhadhana are postponed to the following shuddha masa.

translations.en: Pitru Paksha — the fortnight of the ancestors; auspicious beginnings are set aside.
translations.hi: पितृ पक्ष — श्राद्ध पक्ष; शुभारम्भ वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: The dark fortnight of Bhadrapada is given to shraddha. New undertakings, and this samskara in particular, wait for the following Sharada Navaratri.

translations.en: Chaturmas — the four months of Vishnu's repose; a period of restraint, though Garbhadhana is not absolutely barred.
translations.hi: चातुर्मास — संयम काल; गर्भाधान पूर्णत: वर्जित नहीं।

rules.interpretation: Marriage and upanayana are suspended for the whole of Chaturmas (Devashayani to Prabodhini Ekadashi). For Garbhadhana the texts counsel restraint rather than prohibition, so this is a modest penalty and not a veto. Households observing a strict Chaturmas vrata should treat it as a bar.

translations.en: Panchaka — Moon in the last five nakshatras (Dhanishtha 2nd half to Revati); certain acts are repeated fivefold.
translations.hi: पंचक — धनिष्ठा उत्तरार्ध से रेवती; कर्म पंचगुण होने की मान्यता।

rules.interpretation: The Panchaka prohibition targets specific acts (roofing, cremation, bed-making, fuel-gathering, southward travel) rather than samskaras, so the penalty here is small. Note the engine flags the whole of Dhanishtha, not only its second half — a deliberate over-inclusion documented for the user.

translations.en: Bhadra (Vishti karana) rules part of this day — auspicious acts are suspended during that window.
translations.hi: भद्रा (विष्टि करण) — उस काल में शुभ कार्य वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: The veto for Bhadra is carried by MC_KAR_06 in mc_karana.json; this row adds the calendrical penalty so the day is also visibly downgraded in the prohibited group.

translations.en: Amavasya — a Parva day given to the ancestors; Garbhadhana is prohibited.
translations.hi: अमावस्या — पर्व एवं पितृ-तिथि; गर्भाधान वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Restated here as a calendrical bar so that the Avoid headline reads 'Amavasya' even if tithi weighting is changed in a future profile.

translations.en: Purnima — Parva day; conjugal union is set aside.

rules.interpretation: Parva-varjya applies to the full Moon as it does to the new Moon, the eighth and the fourteenth.

translations.en: Chaturdashi (either paksha) — Parva day; union prohibited.
translations.hi: चतुर्दशी (दोनों पक्ष) — पर्व तिथि; सहवास वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Matches tithi_idx 13, i.e. the fourteenth of both the bright and the dark fortnight.

translations.en: Ashtami (either paksha) — Parva day; continence enjoined.
translations.hi: अष्टमी (दोनों पक्ष) — पर्व तिथि; ब्रह्मचर्य विहित।

rules.interpretation: Penalised but not vetoed: the Ashtami injunction is stated less absolutely than that for Amavasya, Purnima and Chaturdashi.

translations.en: Ekadashi (either paksha) — a fasting day observed with brahmacharya.
translations.hi: एकादशी (दोनों पक्ष) — उपवास एवं ब्रह्मचर्य का दिन।

rules.interpretation: For households that keep the Ekadashi vrata this amounts to a bar; the engine treats it as a strong penalty so that the choice remains with the user.

translations.en: Vyatipata or Vaidhriti — a maha-pata yoga; auspicious acts are suspended.
translations.hi: व्यतीपात अथवा वैधृति — महापात योग; शुभ कर्म स्थगित।

rules.interpretation: The two maha-patas arise when the Sun's and Moon's declinations are equal and opposite. Treated as a heavy penalty rather than a veto, since the yoga rarely spans a whole civil day.

translations.en: Gandanta junction nakshatra (Ashlesha / Mula / Revati) — the water-fire seam.
translations.hi: गण्डान्त नक्षत्र (आश्लेषा / मूल / रेवती) — जल-अग्नि सन्धि।

rules.interpretation: Only the junction padas are strictly gandanta; the engine cannot resolve padas at date level, so the penalty is small and the caveat is shown. Note Revati otherwise scores highly — the two are combined, not contradictory.
